div.div:
1. Only a Federation agronomist with MFA under 10 min authorizes; never the pilot, never a trigger (ADR-002).
2. The mission package is preloaded; the drone flies offline and uploads when the link returns.
3. Without verification photos and track the case stays open and alarms fire.
4. Solid = live call or upload; dashed = offline flight or response.
